name: Shinkonzuma Shion no AV Debut ~Honeymoon Chuu ni Otto Igai to Namadashi Rankou Netorare~
original_name: 新婚妻紫音のAVデビュー～ハネムーン中に夫以外と生出し乱交寝取られ～
source:
Shizuya and Shion celebrate their honeymoon by sharing a nice romantic evening at a fancy resort, they’re on cloud nine and nothing could ruin this ultra lovey-dovey relationship! Unfortunately… The next day they head down to the beach and the second Shion’s husband leaves her side she is pounced upon by the ravenous masses and this honeymoon takes a turn.

In a whirlwind Shion finds herself stripped being groped by strange men and even dragged back to their hotel as she suffers from acute cock shock drooling over the massive cocks of these hung strangers. After blitzing through every sex position under the sun Shion calls her husband letting him know, loud and proud, she is addicted to these men’s cocks and she WON'T be coming home with him!

Some time passes, Shizuya’s life has completely fallen off a cliff. His boss was arrested for embezzling money which has sort of made him unhireable and the only solace he had left is now in jeopardy as he was browsing through shelves of AVs and spots a new DVD on the shelf, with Shion on it!

Does he buy the video to see what exactly happened on their honeymoon to make things turn out this way?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4241510/]Steam[/url]]
